content: MDN: browser-origin storage is best-effort by default; browsers apply varying quotas and eviction policies, with storage pressure or inactivity as triggers. localStorage is small and synchronous; QuotaExceededError must be handled. IndexedDB is asynchronous structured storage, but remains subject to browser eviction. Provide export/restore and explicit data-loss messaging; consider navigator.storage.persist() without promising it will be granted. Sources: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Storage_API/Storage_quotas_and_eviction_criteria ; https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/IndexedDB_API
